frequency_question: How often does a legislative body successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval to block a submitted 123 agreement within the required review window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements submitted by the executive to Congress for the statutory review period where a resolution of disapproval was introduced and brought to a vote. Excludes informal negotiations and agreements not formally submitted.
window: Within the 60 or 90 days of continuous session provided by the statutory review period.
provenance_note: claims 22 cases from only 3 named (7.3x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 22 named submissions; covers all formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress since 1954.
known_gaps: Informal withdrawals before formal submission are not counted as blocked statutory resolutions.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreement review cycles submitted to Congress where a resolution of disapproval reached floor votes.
multiplier: 0 successful blocking resolutions out of over 20 submitted formal 123 agreements historically.
validity_reason: Statutory framework governing nuclear cooperation agreements remains stable across administrations.
